page.overview:
Who is Emoch Akagarti's daughter?

The daughter of Emoch Akagarti and his wife was a female individual. She was present when members of the remnant Partisan cell called the Dreamers broke into her family's home to find evidence of his corruption. She was held hostage with her mother and her brother when the Dreamer's took Emoch to the Affadar water purification plant.
